classification.difficultyReason: Construct the relevant right triangle, including a height difference in part a, use the explicitly requested Pythagoras procedure, then use the missing length in the face-area sum.

content.prompt:
Find the surface area of these solids.
First calculate the missing length using Pythagoras’ Theorem.

spec.description: Unshaded trapezoidal prism with front cross-section at left and extrusion upwards and right. Both bottom corners have right-angle markers. Ordinary source outlines and labels are rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Cross-section parallel vertical sides 19 cm and 11 cm, perpendicular separation 15 cm, sloping top x; prism length 21 cm. Explicit front, right and top visible faces; rear-left edges are occluded.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible; calculated lengths and areas belong to answers.

answer.worked:
The height difference is $19-11=8\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}x^2&=15^2+8^2\\x^2&=289\\x&=17\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Front and back: $2\times\frac{15}{2}(19+11)=450\text{ cm}^2$.
Left: $19\times21=399\text{ cm}^2$.
Right: $11\times21=231\text{ cm}^2$.
Top: $17\times21=357\text{ cm}^2$.
Bottom: $15\times21=315\text{ cm}^2$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Surface area}&=450+399+231+357+315\\\text{Surface area}&=1752\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Low, wide parallelogram prism with dotted perpendicular-height construction at right, right-angle marker, curved 45 mm offset leader and matching single/double parallel arrows. Ordinary marks and labels are black.
spec.mathematics: Parallelogram cross-section has base 175 mm, sloping side 53 mm, horizontal offset 45 mm and perpendicular height x. Prism length is 115 mm. Explicit front, left and top visible faces; rear and bottom edges are occluded.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, parallel markers and unknown x are visible.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}x^2+45^2&=53^2\\x^2&=53^2-45^2\\x^2&=784\\x&=28\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$
Front and back: $2(175\times28)=9800\text{ mm}^2$.
Left and right: $2(115\times53)=12\,190\text{ mm}^2$.
Top and bottom: $2(115\times175)=40\,250\text{ mm}^2$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Surface area}&=9800+12\,190+40\,250\\\text{Surface area}&=62\,240\text{ mm}^2\end{align*}$$
